items.definition:
a device that removes something
The kitchen has a powerful extractor fan to remove cooking smells.

a person who studies the future and makes predictions about it
The conference featured a renowned futurist discussing AI's impact.

a person who delivers ice; a person who is emotionally cold
The iceman delivered a block of ice for the cooler.

a person who is being interviewed
The interviewee answered all the questions clearly.

a person who joins things, especially a skilled carpenter who makes fittings for buildings
The joiner carefully fitted the new door frame.

a small sled for one or two people, ridden in a prone or supine position
The athlete sped down the ice track on a luge.

a type of palm tree, especially one with fan-shaped leaves
The garden was filled with various tropical plants, including several palmetto trees.

a flat-bottomed boat or a floating support for a bridge
They built a temporary pontoon bridge to cross the river.

the act of changing the order or position of things
The rearrangement of furniture made the room feel larger.

surface water in abnormal quantity resulting from heavy falls of rain or snow
The city is implementing new systems to manage stormwater runoff.

a large, hairy spider, typically tropical, that can bite but is not usually dangerous to humans
He kept a pet tarantula in a glass enclosure.

a seabird
A tern swooped down to catch a fish.

a tightly stretched rope or wire on which acrobats perform
The acrobat walked across the tightrope with incredible balance.

a weak or cowardly person
Don't be such a wimp; just try it!

a person or machine that performs consistently well, especially over a long period
That old printer is a real workhorse; it never breaks down.

a device or substance that absorbs something
The shock absorber on the car needs replacing.

a brisk or rapid tempo in music
The piece begins with an allegro movement.

Bricks as a material or structure.
The old church had beautiful, intricate brickwork.

Aromatic spice.
She added a pinch of ground cardamom to the coffee.

A person who charms others.
He was known as a real charmer, always making people laugh.

Sensationalized online content.
Don't fall for that clickbait headline; it's probably misleading.

An unexpected problem or difficulty.
The sudden change in plans threw us a real curveball.

The action of speaking words to be written down.
The secretary took dictation from her boss.

Payment or expenditure.
The company authorized the disbursement of funds.

Disgrace or shame.
He brought dishonour upon his family.

A prayer of supplication in Islam.
Muslims often make dua after their daily prayers.

The outer layer of skin.
The epidermis protects the body from external damage.

A person evacuated from danger.
The shelter provided food and comfort for the evacuees.

Waste matter discharged from the bowels.
The laboratory analyzed the faeces sample.

A gate controlling water flow.
Opening the floodgates released a torrent of water.

The condition of being weak or delicate.
Despite her physical frailty, she had a strong spirit.

A form of indoor football.
They played a game of futsal at the community center.

A flock of geese; a disorderly group of people.
A gaggle of tourists followed the guide.

a large iron or steel beam or compound structure used for building bridges and the framework of large buildings
The bridge was supported by massive steel girders.

a person who tends a herd of animals
The sheep herder used his dog to gather the flock.

Korean pancake
We ordered a variety of jeon, including kimchi jeon and seafood jeon.

a communal settlement in Israel
Life on a kibbutz involves shared responsibilities and resources.

voice box
The vocal cords are located in the larynx.

an Indian prince or king
The maharaja lived in a magnificent palace.

a female head of a family or tribe
The matriarch of the family made all the important decisions.

a film bearing a miniature photographic copy of a document
Old newspapers are often stored on microfilm in libraries.

guerrilla fighters in Islamic countries
The mujahideen fought against the invading forces.

the process of bringing a private industry or company under state control
The government announced the nationalization of the railway system.

the act or process of coming into being or of beginning something
The origination of the idea can be traced back to ancient philosophy.

the condition of being populated with excessively large numbers
Many experts are concerned about the issue of global overpopulation.

a poster or sign for public display, or a notice or warning
The protesters carried placards with their demands written on them.

the period or activities immediately following a sports game
The coach held a brief postgame press conference.

a preconceived idea or prejudice
It's important to approach new ideas without any preconceptions.

the act of making something seem rational or justifiable
His excuse was just a rationalization for his poor behavior.

the act of introducing again
The reintroduction of wolves to the park was controversial.

a fragrant wood
The incense had a strong sandalwood scent.

a small, shiny disc sewn onto clothing
Her dress was covered in sparkling sequins.

liquid waste or messy food
The pigs were fed kitchen slop.

software that enables a user to obtain information about another's computer activities by transmitting data covertly from their hard drive.
Always install antivirus software to protect against spyware.

the male reproductive organ of a flower
The stamen produces pollen in a flower.

a pit or hollow in which liquid collects
The oil collects in the engine's sump.

a close, long-term interaction between two different biological organisms
The relationship between the clownfish and the sea anemone is a classic example of symbiosis.

the first or second stomach of a ruminant, used as food; nonsense
Some people enjoy eating tripe, but I find it unappetizing.

a small loudspeaker designed to reproduce high frequencies
The sound system has a powerful woofer and a clear tweeter.

A method for achieving something or solving a problem without using the usual or intended method.
We found a temporary workaround for the software bug.

a negatively charged ion
An anion is attracted to a positively charged electrode.

an amino acid
Arginine is an essential amino acid found in many foods.

absent without leave
The soldier went AWOL after his leave was denied.

a rod-shaped bacterium
The scientist identified a new strain of bacillus in the sample.
